//: This project serves api.saathi.dev and nothing else. The website is a separate, private
repository with its own Vercel project on saathi.dev — this one is the open-source half.
outputDirectory points at an EMPTY public/ so that nothing is served statically. Pointed at
the repository root, Vercel's filesystem handler runs before the rewrites and serves source
files over HTTP — GET /api/index.ts returned the function's own source. Every path must reach
the function; a request to / gets the app's own JSON 404, the right answer for an API root.
The build command is a gate, not a build: Vercel compiles the function itself, but a deploy
whose generated contract has drifted from the schema would ship a backend whose route list
disagrees with the clients that were generated from the same file.
